body:
📦 **meadow-sailor1046 `d478993`** — art: design durable sailor meals and deliver three matching dish icons

Tim clarified land menus were temporary because artwork was absent. Deliver salt-meat/biscuit, salt-fish/biscuit, and salt-meat/bean stew/biscuit; reserve dry biscuit reuses Sirius TASK-0919 icon. Register only planned artwork; structured menu proposal lists40person-day input batches, conservative calorie balances, separate drinking/cooking water, no alcohol-as-water, explicit supply-chain prerequisites and substitutions. Exact quantities remain design proposals for TASK-1032. No fleet/GOODS/food/recipe runtime mutations.

Gallery19e4138 precedes game import. Full actual prompts, references and master/derivative SHA256, 128px/32px white/dark overview preserved.12 meaningful validation checks pass including calorie/daily-doublecount/water/rum/substitution/icon negatives, missing-image exact key/restoration, and fractional stock rounding example. Current resources/dishes checks pass; four required goods are explicitly absent from main. Offline design validation does not claim live fleet adoption.

Refs TASK-1046

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
(Glossary/personas/meadow.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
